_comment: PS1 (USA) textures that replace PSP (JP) ones: same size/format, text-bearing, same layout. Reviewed, project decision 2026-09-29 (maps and opening pages added the same day). clut=true also copies the PS1 palettes (header 0x100-0x800). See logs/texture_compare.md and build/analysis/tex_compare/review/ for everything that differs.

swaps.why: Weapon-screen labels (Mega Buster, R-ARM WEAPONS, ON HAND, ...). PS1 palette 4 colours the English labels; with the PSP palette 4 they would be green.
TV-station monitors: 'KVV' -> 'KTV' (Kattelox TV, as in the English script) and the on-screen phone number.
Opening prologue page 1 (PS1 English text, renamed on the US disc). PSP palette kept: the English text uses indices 10-15, which the PSP palette also colours as the pale text gradient.
Opening prologue page 2 (PS1 English text, renamed on the US disc). PSP palette kept: the English text uses indices 10-15, which the PSP palette also colours as the pale text gradient.

Opening prologue page 4 (PS1 English text, renamed on the US disc). PSP palette kept: the English text uses indices 10-15, which the PSP palette also colours as the pale text gradient.

MISSION START / MISSION COMPLETE banner (approved 2026-09-29, test31). Pixels differ only in rows 208-247 (the banner); PS1 palette 6 (the banner gradient; the only palette that differs) comes with it. The banner's sprite lists are replaced with the PS1 ones in tools/build_sysmsg.py (the English words are laid out differently).
TV-station building signs (exterior): the PSP's 'VAC' logo -> the US PS1's logo, to go with the KTV monitors inside (intvh20). Project decision 2026-10-01.
